character: A small mottled green and bronze woman of thirty, big gold eyes, smoked goggles pushed up on her forehead, pale burn spots on her fingers.
wardrobe: A stained rubber-cloth apron, sleeves tied back with string, a bandolier of corked glass phials across her chest.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing in a warm cramped workshop inside a ship's hull, glassware bubbling on a bench, an axe hanging on the wall by the door.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Pouring a glowing green liquid between two flasks at a workbench in a dim ship's hold, steam rising, a hatch in the floor open to dark water beside her.
